accounts_days_check.name: accounts_days_check
accounts_days_check.value: ("accounts"."statement_day" IS NULL OR "accounts"."statement_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 31) AND ("accounts"."payment_due_day" IS NULL OR "accounts"."payment_due_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 31)

accounts_dates_check.name: accounts_dates_check
accounts_dates_check.value: "accounts"."opened_on" IS NULL OR "accounts"."closed_on" IS NULL OR "accounts"."closed_on" >= "accounts"."opened_on"

import_jobs_target_check.name: import_jobs_target_check
import_jobs_target_check.value: ("import_jobs"."kind"::text = 'plaid_sync' AND "import_jobs"."connection_id" IS NOT NULL AND "import_jobs"."statement_id" IS NULL) OR ("import_jobs"."kind"::text <> 'plaid_sync' AND "import_jobs"."statement_id" IS NOT NULL AND "import_jobs"."connection_id" IS NULL)

journal_entries_provider_unique.name: journal_entries_provider_unique
journal_entries_provider_unique.where: "journal_entries"."provider_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "journal_entries"."provider_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL AND "journal_entries"."status" <> 'voided'

loyalty_events_sign_check.name: loyalty_events_sign_check
loyalty_events_sign_check.value: ("loyalty_events"."type" IN ('redeem','expire','transfer_out') AND "loyalty_events"."points_delta" < 0) OR ("loyalty_events"."type" IN ('earn','bonus','refund','purchase','transfer_in') AND "loyalty_events"."points_delta" > 0) OR "loyalty_events"."type" = 'adjust'

snapshot_items_target_check.name: snapshot_items_target_check
snapshot_items_target_check.value: ("snapshot_items"."account_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("snapshot_items"."account_group_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

statements_source_check.name: statements_source_check
statements_source_check.value: ("statements"."source" = 'upload' AND "statements"."file_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "statements"."mime" IS NOT NULL AND "statements"."original_filename" IS NOT NULL AND "statements"."size_bytes" IS NOT NULL) OR ("statements"."source" = 'plaid' AND "statements"."connection_id" IS NOT NULL AND "statements"."sync_date" IS NOT NULL AND "statements"."file_sha256" IS NULL AND "statements"."storage_path" IS NULL)
